classification: synthetic TYPE2/TYPE43 solver instrument; not cardboard qualification
mass_units: Mg unless the key explicitly says mg
reaction_semantics: bond_measure establishes that converted T01 nodal reaction output is source-stencil/window averaged; this collector does not treat it as instantaneous endpoint force

quadrature_force_check.sign_convention: restoring interface force on upper substrate is -K*separation; lower force is equal and opposite
restoring interface force on upper substrate is -K*separation; lower force is equal and opposite

approach_endpoint_diagnostics.measurement_limit: Displacement finite differences are not a native velocity channel; endpoint velocity continuity cannot be established from these histories alone.

correct_elastic_path_work_N_mm.method: For each active adjacent sample pair, integrate midpoint(K*delta) dot delta_increment at each of four TYPE43 Gauss points using birth reference area; exact for this linear undamaged law.

elastic_branch_check.limit: This supports using the undamaged linear branch for this synthetic fixture; it is not material calibration.

final_sample_force_check.sign_convention: restoring interface force on upper substrate is -K*separation; lower force is equal and opposite

native_source_basis.area_instrumentation: For the pinned source's ISMSTR=1 path, after the delayed-birth repair initializes the unset state at first active use, its four birth AREAP weights are held through VOL. The calculation reconstructs the paired midsurface at first sampled OFF=1 and reports the four-Gauss summed area per element.
native_source_basis.delayed_birth_repair: The retained repair note records that first active use initializes an unset dormant TYPE43 reference area and frame at the accepted current geometry; the run source commit and binary are recorded beside each case.

source_files_and_lines.engine/source/elements/solid/sconnect/sc: lines 348-360 initialize the frame at TIME=0; lines 474-476 call SDET43
source_files_and_lines.engine/source/elements/solid/sconnect/sd: lines 67-127 derive four AREAP Gauss weights from the paired-face midsurface
source_files_and_lines.engine/source/elements/solid/sconnect/su: lines 312-315 save AREAP in VOL at TIME=0 for ISMSTR=1; lines 357-363 select the saved VOL or current AREAP; lines 601-603 accumulate stress work times the selected AREA
source_files_and_lines.engine/source/materials/mat/mat117/sigep: lines 40-70 identify normal/tangential elastic stiffness; lines 381-392 give undamaged elastic stress as stiffness times separation strain

reference_area_semantics.area_source_limit: Pinned upstream SUSER43 uses per-Gauss AREAP values saved in VOL for ISMSTR=1; the staged-birth repair initializes a dormant element's missing reference area/frame at first active geometry. The current calculation uses that sampled birth midsurface and does not infer unsampled geometry.
reference_area_semantics.geometry_sample: paired TYPE43 midsurface at first sampled OFF=1 accepted birth geometry

invalid_coarse_average_work_diagnostic.method: Across adjacent sampled pairs with both TYPE43 OFF=1, trapezoidal native solid stress components SZ/SXZ/SYZ times nominal face area times per-element mean normal gap/local shear increments.
invalid_coarse_average_work_diagnostic.reason: Multiplying separately averaged stress and separation omits the within-element variance term. It underestimates the work for this nonuniform field and must not be compared as a conservative energy check.

mass_ledger.qualification_limit: Sika density is only an engineering density analogue; 0.05 mm film is an assumption and not measured starch/adhesive geometry.

native_reaction_force_diagnostic.interpretation_limit: Support reactions include the complete deformable substrate and imposed-grip response; residuals measure this synthetic instrument's force transfer and are not paper-interface calibration or a quasi-static gate.
native_reaction_force_diagnostic.reaction_sign_convention: negated native support REAC is compared to the cohesive internal force on the same substrate face

T01.converter_window_policy: same grid as bond_measure: forward first, centered interior, backward last; window-average quadrature force with the pinned th_to_csv source stencil before comparison

T02.converter_window_policy: same grid as bond_measure: forward first, centered interior, backward last; window-average quadrature force with the pinned th_to_csv source stencil before comparison

native_reaction_force_diagnostic.window_semantics: Converted /TH/NODE REAC is a source-stencil impulse-derived time-window average; quadrature traction is averaged over the matching sample window using the same source stencil.
